title: YesStyle on Trustpilot: score, complaints and what the numbers show
seoTitle: YesStyle Trustpilot reviews: score and complaints
description: YesStyle has a 4.4 on Trustpilot, with over 105,000 reviews and 71% five-star. See the complaint themes, and why a global score tells you nothing about delivery to your country.
metaDescription: YesStyle on Trustpilot: 4.4 from 105,000 reviews, delivery complaints and what the score doesn't show. Check delivery to your country before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: [YesStyle](/en/coupons/yesstyle) has a 4.4 on Trustpilot, with 105,442 reviews and 71% five-star. Of the 40 most recent one-star reviews we read, half were about delivery: orders that never arrived, parcels stuck in transit and delays. The score pools buyers from many countries, so check the delivery time and shipping cost for your address before paying.

contentSections.heading: What the score measures
paragraphs: The TrustScore is the profile's score on Trustpilot. The company claimed the YesStyle profile in May 2013 and pays for a Trustpilot subscription, as the page itself states.
The 7% of one-star reviews weighs more than the 4% of two and three stars combined, and that is where the complaints show up. The 4.4 average hides that band.

postParagraphs: To decide, it's more useful to read what the low scores say and how the store answers them. That comes next.

contentSections.heading: Who reviews, and from where
paragraphs: The www.yesstyle.com profile is global. It puts buyers from dozens of countries into one panel, with different shipping, delivery times and customs, and it doesn't split reviews by country.

The store invites customers to review after purchase, whether they're happy or not. In our sample, 30 of the 40 five-star reviews were invitations, and most were short. The one-star reviews came mostly from people who wrote on their own (29 of 40), and they talked about international delivery. So invitations fill the profile with short high scores, while unprompted complaints are where the delivery problems show up.

For you, the score says how the store behaves overall, not how delivery works at your address. At checkout, check the delivery time, shipping cost, import taxes and customs, and the returns policy for your own country.
Who runs the store, the Hong Kong headquarters and the parent company are covered in [Is YesStyle legit?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review).

contentSections.heading: What shows up in the complaints
paragraphs: We read the 40 most recent one-star reviews, and the store replied to every one. By number of cases:
bullets: Delivery, 20 of 40: an order that never arrived or was marked delivered without arriving, a parcel stuck or lost in transit, delays past the estimate on the site, and orders not shipped after weeks. Several say customer service sent them to the carrier.
Product, 9 of 40: missing, damaged, used-looking, incomplete, expired or defective items.
Stock, 4 of 40: items that sold out after ordering, with waits or cancellations.
Returns, 2 of 40: refused because the buyer didn't like the item, or refunded only as store credit.
Other, 5 of 40: an influencer programme, a launch that sold out on the site, the app freezing at payment, a payment check, and a positive review marked one star.

postParagraphs: These reports point to what to check before you buy: the delivery time at checkout, tracking after dispatch and the condition of the packaging on arrival.

contentSections.heading: What shows up in the praise
paragraphs: We also read the 40 most recent five-star reviews. Thirty were invitations from the store, and most were a few lines long. They praise original, authentic products, variety, prices and discounts, well-protected packaging, and delivery faster than expected.

Trustpilot's automatic summary, written by AI from 6,462 recent reviews, points the same way: authentic products, price and packaging. It is Trustpilot's summary, not ours, so we use it only as support.
postParagraphs: Praise and complaints talk about different moments of the purchase: praise is about the catalogue, the price and the parcel that arrived; complaints are about the parcel that was late or never came. The score combines both.

contentSections.heading: What the store replies
paragraphs: The profile says YesStyle replied to 99% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and warns that replies may use AI.
A reply doesn't prove the problem was fixed. Before buying, open a few one-star reviews on the profile and see how the store answered, especially cases about tracking that stopped and lost parcels.

contentSections.heading: Can you trust YesStyle going by Trustpilot?
paragraphs: Yes, with a caveat about scope. The score is good: a TrustScore of 4.4 across 105,442 reviews, with 71% five-star. It describes the store as a whole. For your own purchase, read the most recent one-star reviews and check the delivery time and shipping cost for your country at checkout.

The caveat is about scope. The profile is global, and the complaints are about international delivery: delays, stalled tracking and lost parcels. The shipping cost and delivery time for your address appear only at checkout.
contentSections.emphasis: A global 4.4 tells you how the store handles most orders, but nothing about your address, and delivery is exactly what the complaints are about.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: In the 40 one-star reviews we read, delivery and tracking came up in 20. Before paying, check the shipping cost and delivery estimate for your address at checkout. Rates and how delivery times are counted for each country are covered in [YesStyle's delivery guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).
After paying, keep the order number and the tracking code: you need both to open a ticket with customer service if the parcel is late or tracking stops.

If you've decided to buy, our page on [YesStyle coupons and the reward code](/en/coupons/yesstyle) leads to the store. The link is an affiliate link: a purchase may earn Em Casa com Cecília a commission, at no extra cost to you.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does YesStyle have a good Trustpilot score? Yes. The TrustScore is 4.4, labeled “Excellent”, across 105,442 reviews; 71% give five stars and 7% give one.
What are the most common complaints about YesStyle? In the 40 one-star reviews we read, 20 were about delivery: orders that never arrived, parcels stuck in transit, delays and orders not shipped.
Does YesStyle reply to negative reviews? According to the Trustpilot profile, the store replied to 99% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and its replies may use AI.
Does the Trustpilot score apply to my country? Not directly. The profile is global and doesn't split reviews by country, so check the delivery time and shipping cost for your address at checkout.

What is the YesStyle reward code? CECILIA010 gives 5% off a first purchase and 2% off later ones, with no end date. It goes in the Reward Code field at checkout and can be combined with one of the store's own discounts.
